overview: This comprehensive 4-week curriculum is designed to take a learner with zero prior experience to a functional understanding of data analysis. The course progresses from conceptual foundations and spreadsheet mastery to data visualization and an introduction to SQL databases. By the end of this curriculum, the learner will be able to take raw data, clean it, analyze it, and present actionable insights.
learning_objectives: Define the data analysis process (Ask, Prepare, Process, Analyze, Share, Act).
Navigate and utilize spreadsheet software (Excel/Google Sheets) for data entry and manipulation.
Perform data cleaning and ensure data integrity using sorting, filtering, and functions.
Create meaningful data visualizations and dashboards to communicate insights.
Understand the basics of relational databases and write introductory SQL queries.
